title: Permanent Model Disable on 402 Subscription Required
description: When a provider returns HTTP 402 (subscription/payment required), permanently disable the model until manual re-enable. Includes typed SubscriptionRequiredError, shared newProviderError constructor across clients, CircuitBreaker.DisableModelPermanent, and Engine.processProviderError helper refactoring the 4 duplicated engine error paths. Spec doc: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-04-402-subscription-disable-design.md
